caption:
Gas is finally easing. Still not cheap. ⛽

AAA says the national average for regular is $4.10. A month ago it was $4.37.

But a year ago? $3.08.

Filling a 15-gallon tank now costs about $15 more than it did last year.

Has the price at the pump changed how much you drive?
